summary: Second test pass after Ascendra rebrand. 30/30 backend pytest tests pass (100%) including new persona, multi-turn context, and Google auth coverage. Frontend rebrand verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): landing wordmark 'ASCENDRA', kicker 'AI-POWERED LEARNING · BOUNDLESS GROWTH', hero 'Ready to rise today?', 'Built for your rise' section all present with deep navy/champagne theme. Onboarding → signup with email/password lands in /home with 'Hello · BUSINESS / Ready to rise today, <name>?' greeting, stat row, continue card, all paths, and 'Ask Ascendra' tutor CTA. /login shows both email/password AND 'Continue with Google' button. /tutor header reads 'Ascendra · Your AI learning partner · Claude 4.5' with welcome 'Hi, I'm Ascendra — your AI learning partner ✨'. Sending message returns assistant reply. /paths shows 4 cards, /models shows 22 cards + 7 filter chips. Full path → lesson → quiz → finish flow earns 50 XP (visible on home as 1 streak / 50 XP / 1 lesson). No 'Aida' or 'AI Academy' leakage anywhere. Tutor multi-turn context regression from iteration_1 is FIXED (test_tutor_chat_context passes — Claude recalls '42' across calls with same session_id). New /api/auth/google endpoint correctly returns 401 for invalid session_token. /api/ returns service:'ascendra-api'. The only outstanding minor issue is the deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' RN-web warning (still present, non-blocking).

issues: Bottom tab items still lack testID attributes (testIDs like tab-home/tab-paths/tab-tutor/tab-models/tab-profile would help automation). Carried over from iteration_1.
Path cards on /paths use testID prefix 'paths-card-<id>' while home uses 'path-card-<id>'. Minor inconsistency — consider standardising to one naming convention across screens.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still repeating: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up. Likely from a Pressable/TouchableOpacity/View consumer passing pointerEvents as a prop. Reference: appears on every screen load.

Optional: Standardise path card testID prefix between /home ('path-card-<id>') and /paths ('paths-card-<id>').

/api/auth/google verifies session via httpx call to demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data, upserts user, links Google to existing email accounts — proper error handling with 401/502 distinction.
System prompt now correctly introduces tutor as 'Ascendra' (server.py line ~350); no 'Aida' references remain in backend.
MongoDB queries continue to exclude _id with projection — no ObjectId serialization issues.
Stripe checkout via emergentintegrations wrapper still returns real cs_test_ session_id and stripe.com URL.
Frontend brand tokens (deep navy #070B1F, champagne #E8C572, etc.) applied cleanly — no broken styles observed across landing, onboarding, signup, login, home, paths, tutor, models, lesson screens.
